input.quote: 11.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11 commits us to a five-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals. The only exit rights are non-renewal at expiry (30 days' notice) and termination for material breach or insolvency under 11.2; there is no right for Corio to terminate for convenience during the committed term (Sections 3 and 7 give only refund-linked termination tied to acceptance failure and warranty breach). Absence of any customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback (60–90 days' notice with a capped fee). We therefore added a new 11.2 giving Corio a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no termination penalty, matching the preferred position; the fallback of 60 days' notice is available if needed. Noted but not separately flagged: Commerce One's non-renewal notice is 30 days rather than the preferred 90 days, but that is an end-of-term non-renewal right (mutual), not a mid-term convenience exit, so we have not redlined it here.

proposal.summary: Add Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the five-year committed term currently locks us in with no exit other than breach or insolvency. If you prefer, we can move to our fallback of 60 days' notice.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, without payment of any termination fee, penalty or other charge. In such event, Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination.
